Performance test procedure based on ISO 9906:2012
Performance test procedure for pumps according to ISO 9906:2012.
Test includes capacity, head, speed, power, and temperature measurements.
Records must be kept for 10 years minimum.
Sound pressure level tests must not exceed guaranteed values at rated points.
Bearing temperature test procedure for centrifugal pumps with specific conditions and tolerances.
Running test procedure including capacity, suction head, discharge head, speed, and power measurements.
Impeller balancing using a rotational-balancing-machine according to DIN ISO 1940 T1.
Liquid visible penetrant examination (PT) according to ASME Sec. V, Article 6.
The procedure is for liquid visible penetrant examination on components.
It covers personnel qualification, safety requirements, and penetrant system details.
Visible penetrant (color contrast) will be used for inspection.
The procedure involves using liquid visible penetrant examination (PT) according to ASME Sec. V, Article 6.
Test devices include UV-meter and reference blocks for calibration.
Surface preparation is crucial; parts must be clean and dry before applying the penetrant.
Penetrant application can be done by spraying or brushing, with a dwell time of 10-30 minutes.
Developer dwell time varies from 10 to 30 minutes, depending on conditions.
Inspection involves visual examination for surface discontinuities indicated by bleed-out.
Test results must be documented in the test report and archived according to ISO 9001:2008.
Paint coat application procedure for Rheinhuette Pumpen GmbH.
Product data includes paint system, top coat details, and surface preparation requirements.
Drying times and temperature ranges are specified for the coating process.
Layer thicknesses for first, intermediate, and top coats are provided.
Defects and damages must be repaired before applying further coats.
Test report includes operating data and performance curve for the pump.
Guarantees are provided based on ISO 9906 (2012) standards.
